## C2 — Confusable pairs and knowledge-graph hints: transfer thresholds, permit ages, supervising drivers, exam triggers and skills exam logistics
Confusable pairs among the new-credential rules, followed by continuation facts the main list did not hold; each block ties to one handbook page, and hint metadata sits only in the trailing line of a block.

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A02
An out-of-state license expired for less than five years means a knowledge exam only, while one expired for more than five years means a knowledge exam plus a driving skills test. [A02]
Why it matters: group transfers; confusable under versus over five years expired.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A02
The 60-day deadline applies to a new resident getting an Indiana license, while the 180-day rule applies to holding an Indiana learner's permit when the person was never licensed in another state. [A02]
Why it matters: group transfers; confusable sixty-day versus hundred-eighty-day rule.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A03
A learner's permit applicant aged 16 or older needs documents, a vision screening and a knowledge exam, while one under 16 must also be at least 15 and show proof of enrollment in behind-the-wheel training. [A03]
Why it matters: group permits; confusable sixteen-plus versus under-sixteen applicant.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A04
A relative supervising permit practice must be at least 25, but a spouse supervising permit practice need only be licensed and at least 21. [A04]
Why it matters: group supervision; confusable relative versus spouse age.
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A04
A permit holder under 18 who is in the care of the Department of Child Services may practice with a licensed relative aged at least 25 or with a licensed driver aged at least 25 whom the Department approves. [A04]
Why it matters: group supervision; difficulty medium.
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A04
A permit holder under 18 who is not in driver education may also drive with a licensed driver training school instructor working for a school, or a BMV-recognized certified driver rehabilitation specialist, in the front passenger seat. [A04]
Why it matters: group supervision; difficulty medium.
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A03
An identification card and an MDC endorsement both last six years, while a learner's permit lasts two years from issue. [A03]
Why it matters: group validity; confusable ID card versus permit validity.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A05
The knowledge exam is retaken after a permit has been expired for more than 180 days, and any time spent holding a valid permit still counts toward the 180-day holding period. [A05]
Why it matters: group permits; difficulty medium.
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A05
Active-duty military members, spouses or dependents whose Indiana license has been expired more than 180 days and who returned from service outside Indiana more than 90 days before renewal must take the knowledge exam. [A05]
Why it matters: group exam triggers; scope note military renewal.
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A05
Driver training schools may give the skills exam to any holder of a valid Indiana learner's permit, whether or not the permit carries driver's education restriction J. [A05]
Why it matters: group skills exam; difficulty medium.
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A05
Besides the driver's knowledge exam, the BMV offers knowledge exams for CDL endorsements and for motorcycle, MDC and for-hire operation. [A05]
Why it matters: group exam triggers; scope note other exams.
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A06
A BMV examiner must give the skills exam to new residents under 18 who held an unrevoked out-of-state license for at least 180 days but less than one year, and to new residents holding an out-of-country license. [A06]
Why it matters: group skills exam; confusable school test versus BMV examiner test.
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R13 | anchor: A06
A BMV skills exam is also required when an Indiana license has been expired more than five years, when a BMV restriction requires testing, or when a medical complaint or the medical board leads the BMV to require an evaluation. [A06]
Why it matters: group skills exam; difficulty medium.
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R14 | anchor: A06
Interior cameras must be switched off for the whole skills exam, though backup cameras are allowed. [A06]
Why it matters: group skills exam; misconception all cameras banned.
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R15 | anchor: A06
Skills exam scoring covers lane use and signaling, a safe gap to the vehicle ahead, holding speed and leaving room when being passed, speed control, defensive habits, following instructions and approaching intersections with a full stop when required. [A06]
Why it matters: group skills exam; difficulty low.
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-R16 | anchor: A01
The learner's permit category covers the driver, motorcycle and commercial learner's permits, while the license category covers the driver's license and the CDL. [A01]
Why it matters: group credentials; confusable permit versus license categories.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-R17 | anchor: A01
Indiana began issuing redesigned credentials with new security features in 2019, and older cards remain valid until the expiration date printed on them. [A01]
Why it matters: group credentials; difficulty low.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-R18 | anchor: A02
The full Real ID document list is in Appendix A and at REALID.IN.gov, and the BMV toll-free line is 888-692-6841. [A02]
Why it matters: group Real ID; dynamic contact detail.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0007]

corpus_stability.reason: The Indiana Driver's Manual back cover reads Published July 2026 and tells readers to check IN.gov/BMV for updates; the BMV manual page says printed manuals are updated at most once a year, so the selected pages are treated as stable within a year while fees and service details stay dynamic.
